description: This line plot illustrates the average correct gate rate across different embedding layers for three input types: Character Attention input, Character MLP input, and Wiki MLP input. The x-axis, labeled "Embedding Layer," spans from 0 to 30 with linear spacing and no explicit unit, while the y-axis, labeled "Average Correct Gate Rate," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale. The solid blue line represents the Character Attention input, starting at approximately 0.12 at layer 0, rising sharply to about 0.80 by layer 5, then declining to a minimum of roughly 0.25 around layer 12 before recovering to about 0.70 near layer 30. The dashed blue line, representing the Character MLP input, begins near 0.80 at layer 0, peaks above 0.90 around layer 3, then dips to approximately 0.55 around layer 12 before rising again to about 0.85 near layer 30. The solid red line for the Wiki MLP input starts at approximately 0.20 at layer 0, increases to about 0.80 by layer 5, drops to around 0.35 near layer 12, then fluctuates between approximately 0.55 and 0.70 from layer 15 to layer 30. The dashed red line, which appears identical to the solid red line, also starts at approximately 0.20 at layer 0, rises to about 0.80 by layer 5, declines to roughly 0.35 around layer 12, and then oscillates between approximately 0.55 and 0.70 from layer 15 to layer 30. Each line is accompanied by a shaded region indicating variability or confidence intervals around the mean value.
